book.name: Kereninua
book.title: NENA AMA KEI AWAMUNOYA AWA YOHANE MENI KERENINUA

content: Nuaira ou amire nuaira ni amira ge.
Angelo zo meni nuaira ou gipenu gina. Ou awa koakoa wero itia. Awa Anutu ata Lamara nana arumai simaire amira susura ena osisinoya.

Osero natara ebata soe sieniro susawia. Ou pao enibare enibare amira nuaira ni dopinora. Ni ami inua sero me eure-taure zizinowera. Ni amira gi meni awa zebu serora ema bama meni puro ewanana wamunora.
Nena warure zo nata amira oko itamunoya. Anutu ata Lamara arumai simaire nata amira itai ema dubu nuso nukare sou bua nuso inoise nu bowi inoise nuamunora.
Nukare benau nuso gosinoise nuamunora. Ota zazo nuso awa nusokare nana mewene gayai itamunoya.

Nata awa pi oko ziamunoya. Ata damanata waikora zasimai emo oko samunora. Nera kota, Tua Anutu nu nutope zasimai nusokare wamunoya awa. Ago wai nata amira erama nukare dia bua wai gege wero susawise nuamunora awa.
Yesu eya ewesemuro mamunoya.

Angelo meni namore ego senua awa, “Ge awa me memeka awa. Tua Anutu meni Ozana nuso porofete nana iyetitinowia ami angelo nuso iyeti mai sou nuso nikare nena be iboi tepo eya kei awaise sai awa sero gipero awetia awa.”
Yesu meni ego toya, “Ei giu! Na apunu-kaka gege mamunona awa. Are zo nu buku emira ge gayai awa puro nuamunoya ami yawa sara wamunoya awa.”
Na Yohane, na natope nena awa giro tepo wena awa. Giro tepo wero angelo namore tani gipenua amira nana bawa diro nu bowi wamu wena
nu azu sero ego senua awa, “Ago oko wase! Na soumai otao niso, ata porofete otao mamai nisora otao, ata buku emira ge dia wero baitiro puro nuamunora amira otao dai. Ni Anutu gege bowi weyo.”
Ago sero namore ego senua awa, “Ni buku emira nena ama kei awamunoya amira ge itia awa oko gazero bezase. Ge awa me waise sero be nuso zorage awinoya awa.

Are ema zo nu tani waya inowia ami tani waya wamu wero giro ago waise. Ota duba inagayaire meni duba inagayaire nuamu wero giro ago nuaise. Ota Tuara gera nowia ami Tuara gera dago nuaise. Ota duba saramaire nowia ami duba saramaire dago nuaise.”
Tua Yesu meni ego toya ewa, “Ei giu! Nama apunu-kaka gege mamunona awa. Emara wai amira ina puro mamunona. Puro muro nuai nisokarera te potamunona awa.
Na gitare amare; na susure gomire; na nena zaawaire tepo waire amira mama.”
Tama woi nusokare sewawera sara-kisarapitinowia nukare yawa sara wamunora. Nera kota, nukare awa sana nuaira ni amira me namunora awa. Ota nata amira mokara toiro itamunora.

Nata atura erama ego ine nuamunora: Ema waya-kawaya suna ine, ata ema kayore nowera, ata ema kuma inowera, ata ema mai dawera betinowera, ata ema tua opi bowi inoise puro nowera, ata ema opi puro noise gawera me gege inowia awa. Nukare ago ine ami nata atura nuamunora.
Yesu meni ewesemuro mamu towia, are nakai ina nu maise sanekai.
“Na Yesu, na natope angelo naso iyetina nune ami kerenai ge awa dubu naso nimorekare kereninua awa. Na awa na Dawidira diai susu ata osi nuso ine. Na moroa bamu zasimaire.”

Ozana ata Yesura gegenai dubu nukare Yesure ego towera awa, “Ni muyo.” Ota zo nu ge ei awa niniro da ago saiseyo, “Ni muyo.” Zo nu ou uza betero giro ego maiseyo. Ota zo nu nuaira ou emo towia ami muro ou awa zuma tepo naise.
Yohane meni potai ge potinua.

Buku emira kerenai ge gayai itia awa azimuro niniro awamunowa nimorekare potai ge potana niniu. Zo nu duba nusora ge zo buku emira susumamunoya, ema awa nu Anutu meni yaya-buyayare nena gorobare buku emira gayai itia awa nuso nana susumamunoya.
Zo nu ge emira agewa azu sero disamunoya, awa Anutu meni nuaira ni ata saramai nata awa buku emira gayai itia da ago ine nuso nana ena soyamunoya. Nena amira uge awa buku emira gayai itia.
Kerenai ge ei awa soga inowia ami ego toya ewa, “Me memeka, na eya mamunona awa.” Me memeka, Tua Yesu, ni muyo!
Tua Yesura dumi yagaba meni nisokare nana itaiseyo.
